title: A Choir for the Salt
author: Xanthe Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Delacroix, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
